lang.description: BCP 47 language tag of this locale, used for <html lang>.

extDescription.message: Open-source two-factor (TOTP) authenticator. Codes are made on your device, secrets stay encrypted, auto-fill is opt-in per site.

setupIntro.message: Your accounts are encrypted with this passphrase and stored only on this device.

setupWarning.message: It cannot be recovered. If you forget it, the saved accounts cannot be decrypted.
setupWarning.description: One-line warning shown when creating the vault.

unlockIntro.message: Enter your passphrase to see your codes.

emptyHint.message: Scan a QR code, paste an otpauth:// link, or type in a setup key.

deleteConfirm.description: Armed delete button; a second click deletes.

scanTabHint.message: Finds a QR code on the visible part of the current tab.

scanFileHint.message: A screenshot or a saved QR picture.

dropHint.message: Drop an image here, paste one (Ctrl+V / ⌘V), or choose a file.

errScanTabNeedsPopup.message: Page scanning works from the toolbar button only. Open the page that shows the QR code, click the zauthenticator icon, and try again.

errCaptureFailed.message: This tab can't be captured. Browser pages and extension stores are off-limits; try a regular web page.

errCaptureNoAccess.message: zauthenticator can only capture the tab it was opened on. Click the toolbar icon on the page that shows the QR code and try again.

errNoQrTab.message: No QR code found on the visible part of the page. Scroll it into view or zoom in, then try again.

errNoQrImage.message: No QR code found in that image.

errDecoderMissing.message: The QR decoder failed to load.

errImageTooLarge.message: That image is too large to scan (limit: 20 MB and 50 megapixels).

errImageFormat.message: Use a PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or BMP image.

errNotOtpauth.message: That QR code is not a two-factor setup code (otpauth://).

errMigration.message: Google Authenticator export codes (otpauth-migration://) aren't supported yet. Add each account from its own QR code or setup key.

errNoLinks.message: Paste at least one otpauth:// link.

errNameRequired.message: Enter a service or an account name.

errAllDuplicates.message: Already in your list, so nothing was added.

exportHint.message: The backup is encrypted with your passphrase and excludes the passkey. It shares an encryption key with the live vault, so keep it safe.

errImportNoPass.message: Enter the passphrase for that backup.

errImportFile.message: That file isn't a zauthenticator backup.

errImportTooLarge.message: That file is larger than 2 MiB, too large to be a zauthenticator backup.

autoLockHint.message: Locks 15 minutes after you last use it (or when an extension you chose ends) and when the browser quits.

openTabHint.message: If the file picker closes this popup, open settings in a tab.

securitySummary.message: No network access, no telemetry. Secrets are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM, under a key that only your passphrase (PBKDF2) or a registered passkey can unlock, and never leave this device.

clockHint.message: Codes rejected? They are computed from your computer's clock, so make sure the date and time are set automatically.

bindIntro.message: From now on, this account's code is filled in on this site whenever zauthenticator is unlocked.

bindPermissionHint.message: Your browser then asks you to allow access to this site only.

bindDenied.message: Access to the site wasn't allowed, so nothing was saved.

bindExpired.message: This request expired. Right-click the code field and choose the account again.

bindNoAccount.message: That account no longer exists. Nothing was saved.

bindingsHint.message: Codes are filled in automatically on these sites while zauthenticator is unlocked.

bindingsEmpty.message: No sites yet. Right-click a code field on a site and choose an account to add one.

passkeyHint.message: Keep your passphrase for recovery. Your browser will ask twice when adding a passkey.

passkeyRemoveConfirm.message: Remove this passkey from this browser?

passkeyRemoved.message: Removed from this browser. Old backups are not affected. Delete the passkey on your phone or key too.

passkeyCancelled.message: Passkey request cancelled or timed out. Try again.

passkeyNoPrf.message: This passkey did not provide the required PRF secret. Try another passkey.

passkeyMismatch.message: The passkey returned inconsistent results. Try another passkey.

passkeyFailed.message: Passkey request failed. Try again or use your passphrase.

passkeyOrphan.message: A passkey may remain on your phone or security key. Delete it there if you do not need it.

extendHint.message: Keep it unlocked longer, for example while an AI agent uses this browser. Lock or quitting the browser still ends it.

extendWarnText.message: Until $TIME$, anyone using this browser, an AI agent included, can see, copy and fill your codes without the passphrase. Locking or quitting the browser ends it sooner.

extendFinalText.message: Your codes stay open for $LENGTH$, until $TIME$. Do you really want this?

extendResetDone.message: Back to 15 minutes after the last use.

passChangeHint.message: Change the passphrase that opens this vault. A registered passkey is removed, and other open windows lock.

passNoneHint.message: No passphrase: this vault opens with a key this browser keeps on this computer. Anyone who uses this browser can see your codes.

passRemoveNeedsCurrent.message: Enter the current passphrase to remove it.

passRemoveWarnText.message: Anyone who can use this browser on this computer, a person or an AI agent, will see and fill your codes without a passphrase. Your accounts stay encrypted with a key this browser keeps; if this browser profile is lost or its extension data is cleared, they are gone unless you have a backup. A passkey is removed too.

passRemoveFinalText.message: Remove the passphrase from this vault now? You can set a new one later in Settings.

passChangedPasskey.message: Passphrase changed. The passkey was removed; add it again if you want it. Delete the old one on your phone or key too.

passSet.message: Passphrase set. The key this browser kept was deleted.

passRemoved.message: Passphrase removed. This vault now opens without one in this browser.

passRemovedPasskey.message: Passphrase removed, and the passkey with it. Delete the passkey on your phone or key too.

exportHintNoPass.message: This vault has no passphrase, so the backup file gets its own. Keep the file and that passphrase somewhere safe.

exportPassLabel.message: Passphrase for the backup file (at least 8 characters)

deviceKeyMissing.message: This vault has no passphrase, and the key this browser kept for it is gone. It cannot be opened here. Reinstall the extension and import a backup.

unlockDevice.message: No passphrase · stays unlocked in this browser

xpEntryHint.message: Move accounts to another app: copy otpauth:// links or show QR codes that Google Authenticator imports.

xpWarning.message: Links and QR codes hold the secret keys. Anyone who sees or copies them can make your codes.

xpGatePass.message: Re-enter your passphrase to show secret keys

xpCopied.message: Copied $N$ otpauth:// links, one per line. They hold the secret keys: paste them only where you mean to.

xpSkippedInvalid.message: $N$ with an invalid key left out.

xpNoneValid.message: None of the selected accounts has a valid key.

xpGoogleHow.message: On the phone: Google Authenticator → menu → Transfer accounts → Import accounts, then scan every QR in order.

xpSingleHow.message: Any authenticator app scans it. Google Authenticator: + → Scan a QR code.

xpNotGooglePeriod.message: Not in the Google Authenticator transfer QR: its codes do not change every 30 seconds.

xpNotGoogleDigits.message: Not in the Google Authenticator transfer QR: it has 7-digit codes.

capsUnknown.message: Caps Lock: shown at the first key
